role: library-level timing control
interpretation: maternal transcripts; acts on whole libraries

role: the undifferentiated state from which the first decisions start
interpretation: pluripotency genes (pou5f3, nanog, soxB1); lost from 60% epiboly in most cells

location_signals: outermost cell layer of the blastoderm
role: first lineage split after MBT; a distinct population at every stage
interpretation: enveloping layer, an epithelium covering the embryo; becomes the periderm; a clear switch-like program

location_signals: scattered clusters; specified by inherited germ plasm
role: a population outside the somatic decisions; a positive control for a rare population
interpretation: primordial germ cells; few cells per embryo

location_signals: vegetal edge of the blastoderm (germ ring); Nodal from the YSL and the margin itself
role: the mesendoderm before internalization; the hypoblast/epiblast decision around 6 hpf starts here
interpretation: marginal cells that internalize to form mesoderm and endoderm; split by fate along the margin

location_signals: dorsal margin; maternal beta-catenin targets, then Nodal
role: the dorsal-ventral decision: the organizer protects the dorsal side from BMP
interpretation: the shield (Spemann organizer); gives rise to prechordal plate and notochord

location_signals: dorsal margin, ahead of the shield
role: a small population at the focus stages (shield, 60% epiboly)
interpretation: dorsal forerunner cells, which form the Kupffer's vesicle (left-right organ); shares genes with EVL and endoderm

location_signals: margin, closest to the edge; highest Nodal
role: the endoderm/mesoderm decision of the hypoblast
interpretation: endoderm (sox32/sox17 cells); gut and its derivatives

location_signals: hypoblast; Nodal, FGF, Wnt and BMP along the margin
role: the internalized side of the hypoblast/epiblast decision
interpretation: mesoderm before it splits into paraxial, lateral and intermediate parts; broad, largely unsupported

location_signals: lateral margin, then segmental plate; Wnt, FGF, Notch oscillator
role: paraxial mesoderm, the source of somites
interpretation: tbx6/tbx16 paraxial mesoderm; segmental plate with the her/Notch clock from bud on

location_signals: ventral margin converging at the vegetal pole; Wnt, FGF, BMP
role: posterior progenitors (neuromesodermal) at the end of gastrulation
interpretation: tailbud with cdx and ntl/tbxta genes; feeds the posterior body

location_signals: next to the notochord; Hedgehog from the axis
role: first muscle and somite fates
interpretation: adaxial cells (slow muscle precursors) and forming somites

role: lateral plate decisions (blood, vessels, heart, kidney) begin at bud
interpretation: lateral plate mesoderm with haemato-vascular precursors

location_signals: between paraxial and lateral plate mesoderm
role: kidney precursors, a lateral fate
interpretation: intermediate (pronephric) mesoderm

role: heart precursors at the end of the range (6-somite)
interpretation: heart field (nkx2.5/2.7, hand2)

location_signals: first internalized dorsal cells; highest Nodal
role: the anterior axial fate, which patterns the forebrain
interpretation: prechordal plate (gsc, frzb); its anterior part becomes the hatching gland

role: a terminal fate of the prechordal plate
interpretation: hatching gland (he1a, ctsl): a clear switch-like program from bud

location_signals: dorsal midline; Nodal, then low Wnt
role: the posterior axial fate before the notochord differentiates
interpretation: axial chorda mesoderm (noto/flh, foxa2) during gastrulation

location_signals: dorsal midline, under the neural plate
role: differentiated axial structure; source of Hedgehog
interpretation: notochord (col2a1, col8a1, ntd5) from bud on

location_signals: dorsal ectoderm; low BMP; recorded in ZFIN from 50% epiboly
role: the neural/non-neural decision of the epiblast, then the neural plate before and during A-P subdivision
interpretation: presumptive neural plate, neuroectoderm, neural plate, keel and rod; broad, mostly unsupported (covers all neural regions)

role: A-P subdivision of the neural plate: anterior
interpretation: forebrain and eye field (six3, rx, hesx1/anf, lhx2)

role: A-P subdivision: the isthmic organizer
interpretation: midbrain-hindbrain boundary (eng, pax2/5/8, gbx2)

role: A-P subdivision: hindbrain rhombomeres
interpretation: hindbrain (krox20/egr2b, hox genes)

table1: (extends Table 1: neurogenesis in the neural ectoderm)
role: the first neuronal differentiation
interpretation: primary neurons (motor, Rohon-Beard, interneurons) from bud on

role: the non-neural side of the ectoderm decision
interpretation: non-neural ectoderm, future epidermis (tp63, gata3); its early genes (dlx3b, foxi1) are pooled into the placodes

location_signals: neural plate border; intermediate BMP, Wnt, FGF
role: the border decision: neural crest
interpretation: neural crest (sox10, tfap2a, foxd3) from 3-somite

location_signals: neural plate border, anterior; preplacodal ectoderm
role: the border decision: placodes
interpretation: preplacodal ectoderm and placodes (six1, eya1, dlx3b, foxi1)

location_signals: margin, then dorsal mesendoderm and axial mesoderm
role: general (received and sent in the same cells)
interpretation: Nodal readouts, ligands (ndr1, ndr2; autoregulated) and lefty (feedback, secreted)

role: general (received and sent in the same cells)
interpretation: BMP readouts and the ventral ligands (bmp2b, bmp4, bmp7a), which are BMP targets themselves; szl (feedback, secreted)

role: where the signal is blocked (secreted antagonists)
interpretation: BMP antagonists made by cells with low BMP; shape the dorsal-ventral gradient

role: where the signal is sent (ligands)
interpretation: the organizer's BMP ligand admp, which goes with low BMP readouts

role: general (received and sent in the same cells)
interpretation: Wnt/beta-catenin readouts and the canonical ligands (wnt8a, wnt3a)

location_signals: organizer and prechordal plate, then anterior neural plate
role: where the signal is blocked (secreted antagonists)
interpretation: Wnt antagonists (dkk1b, frzb, sfrp1a); protect the anterior from Wnt

role: where the signal is sent (ligands)
interpretation: non-canonical Wnt ligands (wnt5b, wnt11) of convergent extension; no readouts

location_signals: margin, then tailbud and midbrain-hindbrain boundary
role: general (received and sent in the same cells)
interpretation: FGF readouts and ligands (fgf8a, fgf24, fgf3, fgf4)

role: where the signal is received (readouts)
interpretation: her/hey targets of Notch

role: where the signal is sent (ligands)
interpretation: Delta ligands (dla, dlb, dlc, dld): lateral inhibition and the segmentation clock

role: where the signal is received (readouts)
interpretation: dhrs3a (feedback); a weak readout

role: where the signal is sent (synthesis)
interpretation: RA synthesis (aldh1a2)

location_signals: anterior neural plate, margin, then tailbud
role: where the signal is blocked (degradation)
interpretation: RA degradation (cyp26a1); RA-inducible, but its pattern follows anterior identity

role: where the signal is sent (ligands)
interpretation: Hedgehog ligands (shha, shhb); the readouts are not heterogeneous

role: a known non-identity axis, to be separated from identity
interpretation: S phase genes

role: a known non-identity axis, to be separated from identity
interpretation: G2/M phase genes

role: technical control (stress during handling)
interpretation: heat shock response (hsp70, hsp90)

role: technical and biological stress control
interpretation: p53 targets (mdm2, cdkn1a, ccng1)

role: negative control: uniform genes should not vary between cells
interpretation: genes ZFIN records only in the whole organism from high to shield

location_signals: syncytium between the blastoderm and the yolk; source of Nodal signals
role: negative control: removed with the yolk before dissociation
interpretation: no YSL cells are expected; genes of the curated programs and other controls are left out, so that only YSL-specific genes remain

role: control for differences in age between the embryos of a library
interpretation: genes higher at the later of two adjacent stages of the same sequencing batch

role: control for differences in age between the embryos of a library
interpretation: genes higher at the earlier of two adjacent stages of the same sequencing batch

role: negative control: should not vary between cells
interpretation: type I interferon response; no immune system yet

role: negative control: should not vary between cells
interpretation: aryl hydrocarbon receptor (xenobiotic) response; embryo-wide

role: negative control: should not vary between cells
interpretation: glucocorticoid receptor response; embryo-wide

role: negative control: should not vary between cells
interpretation: circadian clock; synchronised across the embryo

role: technical control: stressed cells
interpretation: immediate early genes induced by tissue dissociation; flags stressed cells
